definitions.PASS: Observed result met the expected result.
definitions.FAIL: Observed result did not meet the expected result.
definitions.PARTIAL: Only some required layers or environments were verified.
definitions.NOT_RUN: The required environment or authenticated state was unavailable.

browserFullRun.note: The two concurrent failures were the documented third-party YouTube Chromium GPU-driver warning. Both affected unique scenarios passed in isolation; no persistent application failure remained.

performance.claim: The fix corrected the meaningful LCP element without a timing, layout-shift, error, or material transfer regression. No field-performance improvement is claimed before deployment.

findings.summary: Back restored the prior URL and result set but not uncontrolled filter control values.
Sign-out produced transient WebKit RSC fallback/prefetch access-control diagnostics; navigation succeeded and a clean reload was clean.

limits: Production served the starting commit, so branch fixes require a preview physical rerun.
The dedicated account was already complete; fresh incomplete-account return was not tested.
Slow-network, validation/server failure, dark mode, and reduced motion remained automated/source checks.
The resume picker was opened and canceled without selecting or uploading a file, preserving the existing test-account resume.
